# Prof. Chung-Yuan Huang (黃崇源教授)

> Professor of Computer Science and Information Engineering at Chang Gung University, Taiwan. Principal Investigator of the Complex Adaptive Networks and Systems (CANS) Lab.

## About

Prof. Chung-Yuan Huang (黃崇源) is a full professor in the Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering at Chang Gung University (長庚大學), Taiwan. His research focuses on complex adaptive systems, network science, evolutionary computation, computational social science, agent-based modeling, and epidemic simulation.

## Open-Source Research Software

- EpiRank: Epidemic risk analysis using asymmetric commuting networks (Python, Scientific Reports 2019)
- MV17: K-core based multi-attribute node importance ranking in complex networks (Python, Physica A 2015)
- HETA: Parameter-free edge classification for complex networks (Python, Physica A 2019)
- HATA: Directed arc classification extending HETA to directed graphs (Python, IEEE Access 2020)
- BCAT: Bounded confidence and adoption threshold model for opinion dynamics (Python/NetLogo, IEEE Access 2022)
- SRAC-Agent: Self-reputation awareness in evolutionary spatial Prisoner's Dilemma (Python, PLOS ONE 2014)
- AED2: Genetic algorithm for optimizing AED placement (C++/Python, Applied Geography 2012)

## Site Structure

- / (index.html): Single-page application with six content sections:
  - "介紹" (About): 責任與肯定 (Commitment and Recognition) — honors, awards, and the Taipei Honored Contributors to Education recommendation article (default tab)
  - "學術" (Academic): 表現與成就 (Performance and Achievements) — 28 academic performance stat cards (publications, citations, h-index, projects, students, service, career)
  - "程式" (Software): 開源程式 (Open-Source Software) — 8 open-source tools (EpiRank, MV17, CASMIM, HETA, HATA, BCAT, SRAC-Agent, AED2) with paper references and GitHub links
  - "著作" (Papers): 171 publications in 5 categories (44 SCI/SSCI/EI journal papers, 49 international conference papers, 10 book chapters, 49 media commentaries, 19 domestic conference papers)
  - "計畫" (Projects): 37 research projects (22 as PI, 14 as Co-PI, 1 as research member)
  - "維基" (Bio): Brief biography — education, career, research interests, and academic achievements
- /stories.html: Family Stories — 60 personal family stories spanning three generations in Taipei Wanhua
- /CV.pdf: Full academic curriculum vitae (PDF)
- /CYHuang.html: Redirect → index.html#papers (old publications page, now integrated)
- /software.html: Redirect → index.html#software (old software page, now integrated)
- /lab.html: Redirect → index.html#lab (old lab page, now integrated)
